description: Use this to author and evaluate a fillet or chamfer on a kernelCAD Shape. It inserts Shape.fillet(radius, selector, { continuity: G1 }), Shape.fillet({ start, end }, selector, { continuity }), or Shape.chamfer(distance, selector), then returns the patched source and evaluation diagnostics. Constant-radius OCCT fillets expose measured G1 only; G2, G3, and G4 are refused because their support seams remained G1 in the tested mode/tolerance sweep. A linear two-station radius_profile uses the NURBS constrained route on one selected edge and reports its measured result; the planar fixture measured G2, while requests above or outside measured support pairs can downgrade with feature.fillet.continuity-not-applicable. Selectors accept EdgeSelector syntax, including canonical edge refs/query strings, EdgeQuery objects, or { face: canonical name, face label, or face query }. This authors a blend operation but does not extract blend-surface NURBS poles.

continuity.description: Requested fillet continuity; defaults to G1. Constant-radius fillets accept G1 only. With radius_profile, the achieved class is measured and any downgrade is reported. Chamfer rejects this field.

distance.description: Chamfer distance in mm; required for operation:'chamfer'.

radius.description: Fillet radius in mm; required for operation:'fillet'.

radius_profile.description: Optional linear start/end radius profile along one selected fillet edge. When supplied, radius is not required.

selector.description: Optional EdgeSelector: a canonical @kc[...] edge ref/query string, an EdgeQuery object such as { parallel: "X", atY: 10 }, or { face: canonical face name, face label, or FaceQuery descriptor }. Higher-order blend requests require one selected edge.

shape_binding.description: Existing Shape variable name to blend.

name: apply_surface_blend
title: Apply Fillet or Chamfer Blend
